drift_events.summary: AC-5.2 required database-level audit immutability, but auth's audit_log has none — no trigger, rule or revoked grant in any of the three migrations, and five test files call auditLog.deleteMany today. The user had constrained the plan to reuse that mechanism, so the AC was unsatisfiable as written. Escalated to the user with three options; user chose to amend AC-5.2 down to application-level immutability (2026-08-04) rather than add a trigger or a sibling table. Recorded as ADR-0033

design.md specified a free-text country input while plan.md required ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 with a DB CHECK and server-side regex. A manually-typed 'Italia' would have 422'd on exactly the AC-3.1/AC-3.2 degraded path that must always work. Resolved to a bundled ISO list behind the same combobox primitive, with Intl.DisplayNames labels — the only option consistent with the already-approved plan and ADR-0031
